title: Core reduction record and finite quotient calculus
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite extension E/ℚ_ℓ and a scheme W. For every coefficient tensor record T there exists a coefficient derived-system reduction record R whose tensor subrecord is T, together with a finite quotient calculus on that tensor record.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A6 and 0941; sequence projection and finite quotient construction

proof.text: Apply the sequence projection derived adjunction and pushforward-limit projections to the completed coefficient ring and its quotient tower. Transport the resulting functors and projection equations across the strict-system sequence equivalence and identify finite evaluations with the prescribed scalar-derived pairs. Apply the same construction to every finite quotient to obtain the ordinary unit, derived counit and tensor data of the finite quotient calculus.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedReductionCore (T : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E W) :
    ∃ R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W,
      R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors = T ∧
      Nonempty (CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
